title: Fixed monthly return matrix
brief: Turn categorized events into a fixed monthly report.
instructions: For refunded returns whose refund timestamp is in UTC 2024, sum quantities by refund month and reason. Return damaged, wrong_item, and unwanted. Missing reasons in an observed month are zero; months without refunds are absent.
Return only the declared output columns, in their declared order and exact SQL types. Follow the output ordering contract; NULL ordering is explicit.
starterExplanation: This starter exposes return_id,reason,qty,refunded_at,status from returns without solving fixed monthly return matrix.

hints.text: PIVOT maps a fixed reason domain into columns.
Project refund month, reason, and quantity, pivot sums, then replace missing measures with zero.
The boundary has January damaged and unwanted refunds but no wrong_item refund.

dataClaims.sql: SELECT string_agg(DISTINCT reason, ',') FROM returns WHERE status = 'refunded' AND refunded_at >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2024-01-01 00:00:00+00' AND refunded_at < TIMESTAMPTZ '2024-02-01 00:00:00+00'
dataClaims.claim: hints[2]: January refunds cover damaged and unwanted but not wrong_item
